shelves.name: Internet Archive
shelves.about: Video items and web captures. A details, embed, or download URL can play inside the set.

shelves.name: Wayback Machine
shelves.about: Snapshots of pages that are gone. A filed snapshot is a lead until someone attaches a playable embed.

shelves.name: PANDORA
shelves.about: Australia's web archive. The overview says the collection is now in Trove.

shelves.name: Trove
shelves.about: National Library of Australia. PANDORA's captures are in the Australian Web Archive here.

shelves.name: Australian Web Archive
shelves.about: The webarchive host for Trove's archived websites.

shelves.name: WebCite
shelves.about: The site still answers. The service itself is retired; the Wikipedia page says what it was.

shelves.name: Internet Memory Foundation
shelves.about: Defunct in 2018. The organisation's own site no longer resolves. Wikipedia, a Wayback snapshot, and the Arquivo.pt collection are the records.

shelves.name: Arquivo.pt
shelves.about: Portuguese web archive. It holds the Internet Memory Foundation collection.

shelves.name: Cyberfeminism Index
shelves.about: Mindy Seu's index of cyberfeminist sites, and the Inventory Press book.

shelves.name: Inventory Press
shelves.about: Publisher page for the Cyberfeminism Index book.

shelves.name: CLIR
shelves.about: Council on Library and Information Resources. The 1996 task-force report is the archiving document.

shelves.name: Personal Archiving
shelves.about: Donald T. Hawkins, editor. Information Today, 2013.

shelves.name: Averting the Digital Dark Age
shelves.about: Ian Milligan, Johns Hopkins University Press, 2024. The MUSE page is the open-access copy.

shelves.name: Wikipedia
shelves.about: Articles on the clips, the memes, and the archives above.

finds.title: Riemurasia, December 2006
finds.note: A verified Wayback snapshot of the Finnish humor site. Nothing from the site is on the loop.

finds.title: Riemurasia banner, September 2011
finds.note: A captured site-banner SWF. It is an advertisement, not a programme, and the license is unknown, so it is not embedded.
